system: B2O3-doped LPSCl1.6 modelC champion, 128-atom cell (Li58 P8 S41 Cl16 B2 O3; 2 trigonal BS3 units, 3 O on P)
method: standard_dos recipe (tools/electronic/standard_dos): nscf tetrahedra (DOS/PDOS, projwfc) + fixed-occ nscf 25 irr k -> gap from VBM/CBM eigenvalues, NO smearing; QE GPU, USPP 60/480 Ry; run June 2026 on KISTI (b2o3_eos dir)
note: CONFIRMED 2026-07-16 from backup: b2o3_nscf_gap.out prints 'highest occupied, lowest unoccupied level (ev): 2.4717 4.4388' and b2o3_scf_fixed.out agrees on the VBM -> the June slide gap 1.97 was eigenvalue-based all along (NOT a DOS-threshold number); gap, VBM-edge % and N_EF=0 stand as-is. Family: modelc 2.099 -> +B2O3 1.9671 (-0.132, slight narrowing) vs +O LPSOCl 2.2309 (+0.132, widening); both edges stay host-like (VBM = S 3p). Site story (-8..0 eV window): free S2- shallowest (<3p> -1.14, most oxidation-prone) < B-S -2.15 ~ PS4-S -2.23 < Cl -2.99 < O -3.64; B 2p sparse and buried (2 atoms).
outputs: db/properties/b2o3_dos_smooth.csv / b2o3_pdos_element_smooth.csv / b2o3_pdos_element_PERATOM.csv / b2o3_pdos_site_smooth.csv (pre-existing); standard-style figures: tools/electronic/standard_dos/b2o3/fig_b2o3_dos.py (3 PNGs); legacy slide set: tools/electronic/b2o3_dos_pdos_slides.py
_mean3p_method: PDOS-weighted mean of the per-atom site curves over the -8..0 eV valence window (= what the figures display; recomputed 2026-07-16 from b2o3_pdos_site_smooth.csv). Ordering free-S shallowest < B-S ~ PS4-S < Cl < O is the robust result. LPSOCl same-window ladder agrees (free-S -1.0 / PS4-S -2.29 / Cl -2.80 / O -4.13, kgy full-file-range).

mean_3p_per_site_eV_legacy_june_fullrang._caveat: June 2026 values integrated the FULL projwfc range; PS4-S/Cl were dragged ~3 eV down by deep sigma/a1 band weight below -8 eV (not shown in any figure). Window-inconsistent -> superseded for figure/comparison use; kept for provenance.
